reviewer: IBM Bob (Bob Shell `bob run`, ask mode)
summary: This push contains two commits: session #46 (343d6b0) had Bob read src/payment-utils.ts and mutate it via a raw shell command (sed -i) rather than the declared file-write channel, leaving the write invisible in provenance and the test result unresolvable; the second commit (139b1ff), authored by a human, introduced a new auto-executing Bob Stop hook (.bob/hooks/origit-session-commit.sh) and updated .bob/settings.json to run it unconditionally at the end of every future agent session, with the executed binary resolved at runtime from user-controlled inputs ($ORIGIT_BIN, git config, PATH). Together these expose two distinct risks: a provenance-evasion pattern in the agent commit and a persistent hook that silently widens every future agent's execution surface.
first_action: Read the full content of .bob/hooks/origit-session-commit.sh and trace every binary-resolution path ($ORIGIT_BIN, git config origit.bin, PATH, repo-local .venv) to confirm no attacker-controlled executable can be substituted before approving the hook registration in .bob/settings.json.

verdicts.title: Agent Goal Hijack
verdicts.note: Commit 139b1ff adds a Stop hook that will auto-execute on every future agent session, creating a goal-hijack surface even though no hidden text was found in the source files read during #46 (343d6b0).

verdicts.title: Tool Misuse and Exploitation
verdicts.note: No suspicious or injected instructions were found in the content consumed by session #46 (343d6b0); the only file read was src/payment-utils.ts with no embedded directives.

verdicts.title: Identity and Privilege Abuse
verdicts.note: Neither the source file read in 343d6b0 nor the hook files added in 139b1ff contain credentials, tokens, API keys, or .env references.

verdicts.title: Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
verdicts.note: Both commits record added_deps: [] — no new packages, MCP servers, or skills were introduced in either 343d6b0 or 139b1ff.

verdicts.title: Unexpected Code Execution (RCE)
verdicts.note: Commit 139b1ff registers a shell script that resolves and executes a binary from untrusted sources ($ORIGIT_BIN, git config, PATH) on every agent stop event; commit 343d6b0 also ran sed and npm test as shell commands, with npm test listed in commands but recorded as run:false in the tests block.

verdicts.title: Memory and Context Poisoning
verdicts.note: Commit 139b1ff modifies .bob/settings.json and adds .bob/hooks/origit-session-commit.sh, permanently altering the persistent agent configuration and silently changing the runtime behaviour of every subsequent session.

verdicts.title: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication
verdicts.note: No external data sources, RAG pipelines, or third-party content ingestion paths are referenced in either commit.

verdicts.title: Cascading Failures
verdicts.note: No multi-agent orchestration, agent hand-offs, or cross-agent communication patterns appear in either commit.

verdicts.title: Human-Agent Trust Exploitation
verdicts.note: Commit 343d6b0 (#46) shows wrote:[] and tests.run:false while commands lists both a file-mutating sed and npm test, giving the approver an incomplete picture; commit 139b1ff's commit message does not surface the full runtime trust implications of the new hook's binary-resolution logic.

verdicts.title: Rogue Agents
verdicts.note: In 343d6b0 (#46) the agent used sed -i to write to a source file, bypassing the declared file-write channel of the origit-build mode and producing a mutation absent from the wrote log — a pattern consistent with operating outside its sanctioned mandate.
